hook.en: An engineer turns down a higher salary to stay in a company where she leads her own project and is trusted. Money matters, but so do respect, growth and security.
hook.kn: ಒಬ್ಬ ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರ್ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಸಂಬಳ ಬಿಟ್ಟು, ತನ್ನದೇ ಯೋಜನೆ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸುವ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಹಣದ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಗೌರವ, ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಭದ್ರತೆಯೂ ಮುಖ್ಯ.

objectives.en: Identify the incentive used in a given situation

narration.en: An engineer turns down a higher salary to stay in a company where she leads her own project and is trusted. Money matters, but so do respect, growth and security.
narration.kn: ಒಬ್ಬ ಎಂಜಿನಿಯರ್ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಸಂಬಳ ಬಿಟ್ಟು, ತನ್ನದೇ ಯೋಜನೆ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸುವ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉಳಿಯುತ್ತಾಳೆ. ಹಣದ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಗೌರವ, ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಭದ್ರತೆಯೂ ಮುಖ್ಯ.

body.en: Financial incentives are rewards in money or measurable in money. They include pay and allowances, productivity-linked wage incentives, bonus, profit sharing, co-partnership or employee stock option, retirement benefits (provident fund, pension, gratuity) and perquisites such as car allowance or housing.
body.kn: ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಕಗಳು ಹಣದ ರೂಪದ ಬಹುಮಾನಗಳು: ವೇತನ ಮತ್ತು ಭತ್ಯೆ, ಬೋನಸ್, ಲಾಭ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ, ಷೇರು ಆಯ್ಕೆ, ನಿವೃತ್ತಿ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಇತರ ಸವಲತ್ತುಗಳು.

body.en: Non-financial incentives meet psychological, social and emotional needs. They include status, a good organisational climate, career advancement opportunity, job enrichment, employee recognition programmes, job security, employee participation and employee empowerment.
body.kn: ಹಣಕಾಸೇತರ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಕಗಳು ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಅಗತ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಪೂರೈಸುತ್ತವೆ: ಸ್ಥಾನಮಾನ, ವೃತ್ತಿ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ, ಕೆಲಸದ ಸಮೃದ್ಧೀಕರಣ, ಮನ್ನಣೆ, ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಭದ್ರತೆ, ಭಾಗವಹಿಸುವಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ.

points.en: Job enrichment: more variety, challenge and autonomy in the job
Empowerment: giving more autonomy and power to subordinates
Employee participation: joint management committees, suggestion schemes

problem.en: A software firm lets each programmer design a whole module, choose the method and present it to the client, instead of only writing small routine parts. Which incentive is used, and is it financial?

steps.en: The job now has more variety, responsibility and autonomy.
Designing a job this way is called job enrichment.
It gives no extra money, so it is a non-financial incentive.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. A software firm lets each programmer design a whole module, choose the method and present it to the client, instead of only writing small routine parts. Which incentive is used, and is it financial?
Team quiz. Each team discusses and gives one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.

narration.en: Now two questions in the PUC board, CBSE and CUET pattern.

points.en: Financial incentives: pay, bonus, profit sharing, stock option, retirement benefits, perquisites.

points.en: Non-financial: status, climate, career growth, job enrichment, recognition, security, participation, empowerment.
points.kn: ಹಣಕಾಸೇತರ: ಸ್ಥಾನಮಾನ, ವೃತ್ತಿ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ, ಕೆಲಸದ ಸಮೃದ್ಧೀಕರಣ, ಮನ್ನಣೆ, ಭದ್ರತೆ, ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ.

homework.en: Explain any four non-financial incentives with examples from a firm you know.

narration.en: Recap. Financial incentives: pay, bonus, profit sharing, stock option, retirement benefits, perquisites. Non-financial: status, climate, career growth, job enrichment, recognition, security, participation, empowerment. Good managers combine both kinds.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಹಣಕಾಸಿನ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಕ: ವೇತನ, ಬೋನಸ್, ಲಾಭ ಹಂಚಿಕೆ, ಷೇರು ಆಯ್ಕೆ, ನಿವೃತ್ತಿ ಸೌಲಭ್ಯ. ಹಣಕಾಸೇತರ: ಸ್ಥಾನಮಾನ, ವೃತ್ತಿ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ, ಕೆಲಸದ ಸಮೃದ್ಧೀಕರಣ, ಮನ್ನಣೆ, ಭದ್ರತೆ, ಸಬಲೀಕರಣ. ಉತ್ತಮ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕರು ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
